call_points.text: Kyushu Yanagawa collaboration implemented at Karoli; first high-pressure die-cast alloy wheel supplied to a leading Japanese customer.
Wheel Assembly sales are nil from 01.04.2026 after the strategic closure of the low value-added business.
Advanced Braking Systems holds ~50% market share in Indian 2W braking.
Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 12.1% from 12.5%; without alloy pass-through it would be 80 bps higher.
Margin gain came from volume scale, higher utilisation at Karoli and the new Bangalore facility, and the Wheel Assembly cut.
Advanced Braking Systems FY26 revenue ₹1,632 Cr, up 17%; Safety Control Cables ₹157 Cr, up 14%.
Company claims ~50% market share in 2W Advanced Braking Systems in India.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal pending before CIT (A) for AY 2021-22 against the orders of AO passed u/s 143(3). Two additions were made by AO:- a) profit on sale of immovable property Rs 2,00,000/- and b) CSR expenses Rs 3,02,41,227/- debited in statement of profit and loss . AO ignored the fact that both the additions were already made by the company while calculating the taxable income.Total demand created Rs 81,91,670/-.

timeline.summary: Vijay Rathee, Lijay Rathee, Prashant Rathee, and Aman Rathee (Promoter Group) declared no encumbrances on ASK Automotive shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Kuldip Singh Rathee, Vijay Rathee, Prashant Rathee, and Aman Rathee declared no encumbrances on ASK Automotive shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 4, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,147.12 Cr (+35.0% YoY), net profit ₹71.54 Cr (+24.2% YoY).
ASK Automotive reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,196 Cr (+16.2% YoY) and PAT of ₹297 Cr (+20.1% YoY), with Q4 revenue up 35.3% to ₹1,154 Cr.
ASK Automotive's Q4/FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,196 Cr (+16.2%), EBITDA of ₹551 Cr (+24.1%) and PAT of ₹297 Cr (+20.1%), with EBITDA margin at 13.1%.
ASK Automotive Limited hosted an analysts/institutional investor conference call on May 20, 2026, discussing unaudited Q4FY2026 and FY2026 results.

ASK Automotive Limited schedules earnings call for Q2 & H1 FY27 on November 04, 2026, at 05:00 PM IST with Chairman & MD Kuldip Singh Rathee, JMDs Prashant & Aman Rathee, CFO Naresh Kumar Sharma, and CGM Manoj Sharma.
